info.name: Zip Upload
info.summary: Drag a folder in, get it zipped (stored, uncompressed) and uploaded as a single file.
info.description: Drag and drop a folder onto the Zip Upload page and it will be packed into a single, uncompressed (store-only) zip archive entirely in your browser, then uploaded to a folder of your choice. Hidden files, WaveCache.wfm files, *.bak.???.ptx files and empty folders are excluded by default, and the exclusion rules can be edited before each upload.
info.author: claude-coder-collab
